say:1:1331113401:1.text: Wasn't the princess just here, offering flowers to Dura? How did she vanish into thin air...
say:1:1331113401:1.source_cn: 明明殿下刚才还在这里，还在为女神献花，怎么会突然消失……
say:1:1331113401:1.male: Wasn't the princess just here, offering flowers to Dura? How did she vanish into thin air...
say:1:1331113401:1.female: Wasn't the princess just here, offering flowers to Dura? How did she vanish into thin air...

say:2:1331113402:1.text: ...No, wait! The princess already offered flowers earlier. Why was she doing it again just now?
say:2:1331113402:1.source_cn: ……不、不对！殿下不久前已经为女神献过花了，为什么刚才...
say:2:1331113402:1.male: ...No, wait! The princess already offered flowers earlier. Why was she doing it again just now?
say:2:1331113402:1.female: ...No, wait! The princess already offered flowers earlier. Why was she doing it again just now?

say:3:1331113403:1.text: I remember Lydia asking me to stop sweeping the floor to watch the flower offering ceremony. But now, I'm holding a tray!
say:3:1331113403:1.source_cn: 我记得很清楚，上一次献花的时候，莉娅女士还要求我停下手...
say:3:1331113403:1.male: I remember Lydia asking me to stop sweeping the floor to watch the flower offering ceremony. But now, I'm holding a tray!
say:3:1331113403:1.female: I remember Lydia asking me to stop sweeping the floor to watch the flower offering ceremony. But now, I'm holding a tray!

say:4:1331113404:1.text: What... on earth is going on?
